short_caption: Corner desk beside wall shelves of collectible figures and posters.
literal_description: High-angle view into the room corner where the desk sits. On the left wall, two thin black floating shelves hold small vinyl collectible figures and an anime figure with spiky orange-red hair, next to a poster for an anime film showing a pale face and blue sky. On the right wall is part of a large hand-painted poster of a yellow-haired anime character. The desk holds a laptop, a curved monitor, headphones, a white-and-black gamepad, a mechanical keyboard, a glowing mouse, a black speaker, and a white gamepad on a patterned mat; a game disc rests on the front edge. A gray step platform is under the desk and cables and adapters lie on the beige tile floor at the bottom right.
environment: Small residential bedroom, roughly 3 m by 3 m, with white painted plaster walls, beige square ceramic floor tiles with a matching tile skirting strip, an aluminum-framed casement window with a white roller shutter, and a wood-veneer interior door.
lighting: Even overhead artificial ceiling light, neutral white color temperature, low contrast, soft short shadows under furniture; no direct sunlight through the window.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, smoke, dust, or haze.
ambient_sound: Quiet small-room tone with the low hum of a mini fridge compressor and a soft computer fan whir.
